Settings

Settings are saved on this device. The game stays paused when you close this menu.

How to play

Control: reach 30 signal points or defeat the other team. At the time limit, compare signal points, then survivors, then health. Elimination: defeat the other team, or lead on survivors and then health when time runs out. An exact tie is a draw. Rounds last 45, 90 or 150 seconds. Ranks and stats carry over.

Relic: collect the relic at center and carry it to your home circle. Three deliveries win. Carriers move 28% slower and cannot dash. A defeated carrier drops the relic; either team can recover it. Each delivery resets it at center after two seconds. At time limit: deliveries, survivors, then health.

Saber only: turns off Force attacks for both teams. Movement, guard and sabers still work.

Play

  • WASD or arrow keys: move
  • J: saber strike · K: Force · Shift: dash
  • Hold Space or L: guard
  • Click an enemy in sight to lock on. Tab switches targets while the map is focused; Shift+Tab moves focus off the map. On touch screens, use Cycle target. The yellow ring marks your target. Without a lock, you aim at the nearest enemy in sight.
  • P or Escape: pause. Touch controls work by holding a direction or Guard. Activating these buttons with a keyboard takes a short step or toggles Guard.

Watch

Both teams fight automatically. Select a fighter or use Previous and Next to inspect living fighters. Filter by team, or choose Relic carrier. Arrow keys cycle fighters while the map has focus. To play, pause and select a living teammate.

Higher ranks read attacks sooner, conserve energy, predict visible movement and link form-specific combinations. Ataru vaults have real height and landing recovery. K uses a ready Force ability chosen for the situation; the fighter panel shows its unlocked repertoire. Jar’Kai adds a shorter offhand strike and costs more energy and recovery. Short early attack taps queue for eight simulation ticks; pausing clears them. These moves and rank unlocks are game adaptations.
